tools.name: register
tools.description: Deprecated: returns a sign-up link instead of creating an API key, ignores its arguments and stores nothing. Don't call it to get access — every other tool works without a key (get_signals returns a 3-signal preview, get_stats is public). Users create keys at https://signals.x70.ai/mcp-signup and se

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: List live crypto trading signals that are still open — coin, direction, confidence and the reasoning behind each. Use it to find current trade ideas; use get_signal for one signal by ID (live or resolved), get_signal_history for signals that already closed, and get_stats for aggregate hit rate. No k

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Get one signal by its ID — live or already resolved — with its reasoning, live price, PnL and verification outcome (status pending, success or failed; whether take-profit or stop-loss was hit). Use it to follow up a signal from get_signals or get_signal_history, or to see how a past signal ended. Ne

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate performance of signals created in the last N days (default 30) that have since resolved: hit rate, verified count, average leverage and a breakdown by direction; with an API key also average ROI per signal and cumulative ROI. Use it to judge recent reliability before acting — it returns no

tools.name: get_signal_history
tools.description: List signals that have already resolved (success or failed), newest first, each with its verification outcome. Use it to review past performance signal by signal; for open signals use get_signals, for one signal by ID get_signal, for totals get_stats. Needs an API key. History depth: last 24 hours o

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
